basicInfo.name: Raffael Eloi
basicInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer | Software Architect
basicInfo.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer from Brazil, working remotely with teams in the US and Canada. I specialize in backend with C# and .NET, designing systems on Azure: microservices, event-driven communication with Service Bus, and cloud-native deployments on Container Apps, with Terraform for infrastructure. I care about software that stays maintainable as it grows, which means Clean Architecture, SOLID, TDD and CI/CD pipelines that make frequent releases safe.

I've worked across restaurant tech, online art mentorship, corporate performance management and agribusiness, usually modernizing legacy systems while building new platforms. That work has included cutting cloud costs by more than 30% and bringing a page load from 4.5 seconds down to under 400 milliseconds. I also work across the stack when the product needs it.

Outside my day job, I share what I learn. I organize a .NET community with in-person events and monthly meetups, mentor people starting out in tech, write on Dev.to and Medium, and run a YouTube channel in English about software engineering, architecture and technical books. I'm also growing as a speaker, starting with my first talk on building scalable applications.

Away from the keyboard, I'm into combat sports and MMA, and I'm a bit obsessed with filtered coffee.

experience.description: HungerRush is a leading restaurant technology company that powers thousands of restaurants across the U.S. with end-to-end solutions for POS, online ordering, delivery, payments, and guest engagement. The platform handles a high volume of transactions and integrations daily, connecting restaurants with major third-party delivery and ordering ecosystems.
experience.roleResponsibility: Building and maintaining seamless integrations between HungerRush's core platform and third-party services. Designing and maintaining backend services using C# and .NET on Azure Container Apps.
details: Migrated APIs from Azure Functions to Azure Container Apps, reducing cloud costs by more than 30%.
Designed a data-driven API to centralize common partner integrations, reducing the number of APIs to maintain and shortening the time for new partners to integrate.
Migrated serialization from Newtonsoft.Json to System.Text.Json, enabling native OpenAPI support and a code-first approach to API documentation, replacing the manual SwaggerHub workflow.
Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services that power high-volume external integrations.
Adding new partner integrations and evolving existing ones as APIs and business rules change.
Refactoring and modernizing legacy systems, addressing technical debt, and improving reliability and scalability.
Supporting internal teams by investigating and resolving complex integration-related issues in production.

experience.description: Mastrius is an online mentorship platform and creative community that connects growing artists with experienced master artists for live, interactive mentorship and guided learning. It offers small group sessions, workshops, and personalized feedback designed to help artists refine their skills, find their voice, and accelerate their artistic growth in a supportive, collaborative environment.
experience.roleResponsibility: Joined a small tech team tasked with stabilizing and maintaining legacy systems built with older versions of .NET and Vue, while simultaneously designing and developing a new scalable platform
details: Replaced the WordPress UI with a Vue.js SPA, reducing page load time from 4.5 seconds to 378 milliseconds (over 90% faster).
Created reusable base structures using C# generics, significantly reducing the time to deliver new CRUD features.
Established engineering processes in Azure DevOps, including feature tracking, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, testing, and deployments.
Designed and implemented a new microservices-based architecture using .NET 9, Entity Framework, SQL Server, and ElasticSearch, supporting modularity and scalability across services.
Built three new front-end applications with Vue 3 (Composition API), TypeScript, and Vuetify following an MVVM-style separation of components, controllers, and models.
Contributed to architectural decisions that balanced migrating legacy systems with building new platforms, supporting the company's long-term growth strategy.
Designed software aligned with SOLID principles and Clean Architecture, resulting in maintainable and scalable systems.

projects.name: UFC Events
projects.description: A free app that notifies you by email whenever a new UFC event is announced, so you can add it to your calendar. Every Monday an automation checks the events listed on ufc.com/events and sends the latest ones to subscribers. Just add your email and the notifications start arriving.

contentAndCommunity.title: Raffael Eloi
contentAndCommunity.description: An English-language channel about software engineering, software architecture, cloud services and engineering best practices. The goal is to explain not only how things work, but why they work, when to use them and what trade-offs are involved.
contentAndCommunity.tagline: Real knowledge. Real experience. Real engineering.

contentAndCommunity.title: Swimming Against the Tide
contentAndCommunity.description: A series born from frustration with how much technical content is now AI-generated. Every topic is something I research, study and understand myself before explaining it. It isn't anti-AI. It's about taking personal responsibility for the knowledge I share.
contentAndCommunity.tagline: Real knowledge. Real effort. Real engineering.

contentAndCommunity.title: Show Me the Code
contentAndCommunity.description: A look inside my side projects: the motivation, architecture, technology choices, implementation, trade-offs and lessons learned. The first episode covers the UFC Events app.

contentAndCommunity.title: Book Reviews
contentAndCommunity.description: Software engineering and architecture books through my own perspective: key takeaways, where I agree or disagree, and how the ideas connect to real engineering experience.
contentAndCommunity.tagline: Read critically. Think independently. Share genuinely.
